#version 300 es
precision highp float;
in vec2 vTextureCoord;
out vec4 o_outColor;
uniform sampler2D uTexture;
uniform highp usampler2D uLutTexture;
// Uniforms for applying the crop parameter.
uniform vec2 uResolution;
uniform float uLeftBorder;
uniform float uTopBorder;
uniform float uRightBorder;
uniform float uBottomBorder;
uniform float uScale;
uniform mat4 uYUV2RGBMatrix;
uniform mat3 uBT2020TOBT709Matrix;

vec3 hlgeotf(vec3 x)
{
    return mix(x * x / 3.0, (exp((x - 0.55991073) / 0.17883277) + 0.28466892) / 12.0, step(0.5, x));
}
vec3 hlgootf(vec3 x)
{
    float luma = 0.2627 * x.r + 0.6780 * x.g + 0.0593 * x.b;
    return mix(vec3(0.0), x * pow(luma, 0.2), step(0.0, luma));
}
#define SRGB_A 1.0550107189475866
#define SRGB_C 12.92
#define SRGB_D 0.0030412825601275209
#define SRGB_E -0.0550107189475866
#define SRGB_G 2.4
vec3 srgbeotf(vec3 x)
{
    return mix(x / SRGB_C, pow((x - SRGB_E) / SRGB_A, vec3(SRGB_G)), step(SRGB_C * SRGB_D, x));
}

vec3 srgboetf(vec3 x)
{
    return mix(SRGB_C * x, SRGB_A * pow(x, vec3(1.0 / SRGB_G)) + SRGB_E, step(SRGB_D, x));
}
vec4 getRectRingCropColor(vec2 vVideoTexSamplingCoord) {
    vec4 outColor;
    vec2 uv = vVideoTexSamplingCoord;
    bool isBorder = (uv.x * uResolution.x  < round(uLeftBorder * uResolution.x)) 
                     || (uv.x * uResolution.x > round(uRightBorder * uResolution.x))
                     || (uv.y * uResolution.y < round((1.0 - uBottomBorder) * uResolution.y))
                     || (uv.y * uResolution.y > round((1.0 - uTopBorder) * uResolution.y));
    if (isBorder) {
         outColor = clamp(uYUV2RGBMatrix * texture(uTexture, uv), 0.0, 1.0);
         vec3 tmp = hlgootf(clamp(hlgeotf(outColor.rgb), 0.0, 1.0));
         tmp = clamp(tmp.rgb * 1000.0 / 203.0, 0.0, 1.0);
         tmp = clamp(uBT2020TOBT709Matrix * tmp, 0.0, 1.0);
         tmp = srgboetf(tmp);
         outColor = vec4(tmp, outColor.a);
         //outColor.r = 0.0;
         //outColor.g = 1.0;
         //outColor.b = 0.0;
    } else {
        float Sx = uRightBorder - uLeftBorder;
        float Sy = uBottomBorder - uTopBorder ;
        float offsetX = (Sx * (uScale - 1.0)) / (2.0 * uScale);
        float offsetY = (Sy * (uScale - 1.0)) / (2.0 * uScale);
        vec2 originalUV;
        originalUV.x = uLeftBorder + offsetX + (uv.x - uLeftBorder) / uScale;
        originalUV.y = 1.0 - uBottomBorder + offsetY + (uv.y - (1.0 - uBottomBorder)) / uScale;
        //vec2 center = vec2(uRightBorder + uLeftBorder,  2.0 - (uBottomBorder + uTopBorder)) / 2.0 - 0.5;
        //uv = uv - 0.5;
        //uv += center;
        //uv /= uScale;
        //uv = uv + 0.5;
        outColor =  clamp(uYUV2RGBMatrix * texture(uTexture, originalUV), 0.0, 1.0);
        outColor.r = (float (texture(uLutTexture,vec2(outColor.r, 0.0)).r)) / 1023.0;
        outColor.g = (float (texture(uLutTexture,vec2(outColor.g, 0.0)).r)) / 1023.0;
        outColor.b = (float (texture(uLutTexture,vec2(outColor.b, 0.0)).r)) / 1023.0;
        vec3 tmp = outColor.rgb;
        tmp = srgbeotf(tmp);
        tmp = clamp(uBT2020TOBT709Matrix * tmp, 0.0, 1.0);
        tmp = srgboetf(tmp);
        outColor = vec4(tmp, outColor.a);
        //outColor.r = 1.0;
    }
    return outColor;
}

void main() {
    o_outColor = getRectRingCropColor(vTextureCoord);
}

uniform float uTopBorder;

vec4 getRectRingCropColor(vec2 vVideoTexSamplingCoord) {
    vec4 outColor;
    vec2 uv = vVideoTexSamplingCoord;
    bool isBorder = (uv.x * uResolution.x  < round(uLeftBorder * uResolution.x)) 
                     || (uv.x * uResolution.x > round(uRightBorder * uResolution.x))
                     || (uv.y * uResolution.y < round((1.0 - uBottomBorder) * uResolution.y))
                     || (uv.y * uResolution.y > round((1.0 - uTopBorder) * uResolution.y));
    if (isBorder) {
        outColor = texture(uTexture, uv);
        //outColor.r = 0.0;
        //outColor.g = 1.0;
        //outColor.b = 0.0;
    } else {
        float Sx = uRightBorder - uLeftBorder;
        float Sy = uBottomBorder - uTopBorder ;
        float offsetX = (Sx * (uScale - 1.0)) / (2.0 * uScale);
        float offsetY = (Sy * (uScale - 1.0)) / (2.0 * uScale);
        vec2 originalUV;
        originalUV.x = uLeftBorder + offsetX + (uv.x - uLeftBorder) / uScale;
        originalUV.y = 1.0 - uBottomBorder + offsetY + (uv.y - (1.0 - uBottomBorder)) / uScale;
        outColor = texture(uTexture, originalUV);

        //uv += (uv - center) / uScale 
;        //outColor = texture(uTexture, uv);
        //outColor.r = 1.0;
    }
    return outColor;

uniform sampler2D y_tex;

uniform vec2 xUnit;
uniform vec4 coeffs;

void main() {
  gl_FragColor.r = coeffs.a + dot(coeffs.rgb,
      sample(tc - 1.5 * xUnit).rgb);
  gl_FragColor.g = coeffs.a + dot(coeffs.rgb,
      sample(tc - 0.5 * xUnit).rgb);
  gl_FragColor.b = coeffs.a + dot(coeffs.rgb,
      sample(tc + 0.5 * xUnit).rgb);
  gl_FragColor.a = coeffs.a + dot(coeffs.rgb,
      sample(tc + 1.5 * xUnit).rgb);
}
